The complexity of the file shrank noticeably: the threshold branches that existed in three different places (`classifySignal`, `collectAlerts`, `severityRank`) now live once, in data, so a reader isn't chasing the same decisions across functions. All decisions still produce the exact same outputs — verified by compiling both old and new versions and comparing every validation path, boundary value (`-100`…`1200`), and a mixed multi-channel batch, with byte-identical results.
